As of my last update in October 2023, pgvector is a library for PostgreSQL that supports vector search. The specific versions of PostgreSQL that pgvector supports can vary between releases. To determine the oldest PostgreSQL major version supported by the current release of pgvector, you would need to refer to the latest release notes or documentation on the pgvector GitHub repository or official website.
